Subject: Wrap & quick asset ask — pilot ops snapshot

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the POC. We completed the 6-week pilot last Friday and wanted to share the ops outcomes from our side and ask a quick favor. High level:

- Inference latency (tail p95) dropped from ~480ms to ~120ms for our 1024-token median traces.
- End-to-end request throughput improved ~3.6x with batch-aware routing enabled.
- Cost per 1k tokens (post-optimization) estimates are down ~42% vs our previous setup.

I attached the KPI export (pilot-kpis-olympus-q3.csv) with the sampling window and test harness notes. The product/marketing team at Olympus is compiling a short internal note for execs and asked whether Redwood could provide a one- or two-sentence blurb we can include (public is fine, but we can keep it simple and attributed to our team).

Would you be open to: 
1) A 30-second written quote we can publish in our internal note and share with our external marketing team; or
2) A quick 10–15 minute call next week if you’d prefer to record a short soundbite?

No pressure — just want to capture a line about the performance/cost improvement and the ease of the pilot. If you can email a line back or point us to someone on your side who can sign off, that’d be great.

Appreciate the partnership — the velocity gains here are already helping our recommendations pipeline.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of ML Ops
Olympus Retail

[Attachment: pilot-kpis-olympus-q3.csv (text/csv)]
